title: A session bound to one Engram project cannot name a source root for its claim in another project: termal_name_source_root returns 409 "this session holds no live claim"
outcome: A session that legitimately holds a claim in another project (here a Phoenix-bound session holding a TermAl item) can name that project's worktree as its source root and earn credit there, or the refusal names the cross-project binding as the cause and the supported route.
acceptance: The cause is classified with evidence: which binding the source-root naming path uses to look up the claim.

Either a session can name a source root for a live claim it holds in another project and earn credit there, or the refusal states the cross-project binding mismatch and the supported route instead of "no live claim"; a test covers the case.
